blocks.text: NAGOYA–A “more mature” Zhang Boheng won the men’s all-around gymnastics gold at the Asian Games on Monday, beating his Japanese rivals ahead of next month’s world championships. China’s Zhang overcame an injury niggle to win gold in Nagoya ahead of Paris Olympics champion Shinnosuke Oka and reigning world champion Daiki Hashimoto. Zhang will hope to repeat the feat at next month’s world championships in Rotterdam and he said he had grown as an athlete. “I have kept reviewing my own shortcomings,” said Zhang, who finished second behind Oka at the Paris Olympic Games and again behind Hashimoto at the most recent […]...
